state.initial_idea: Determine whether a FlyWire-derived Drosophila connectome substrate with spiking dynamics and biologically constrained learning provides measurable value for sequential decisions in a partially observable Hearthstone-like environment.
state.initial_context_summary: Research-first program; not an LLM agent. Use FlyWire data and annotations, the existing fly-brain simulation foundation, an independently validated Hearthstone-like environment, modern SNN learning, matched baselines, ablations, and reproducible compute/biological metrics. Full FlyWire plus end-to-end full Hearthstone is not the first target.

rounds.question: What should be the primary claim of the first publishable version?
rounds.answer: Topology value: test whether real FlyWire topology provides an advantage over matched random/shuffled controls.

rounds.question: What environment boundary is accepted for the first publishable topology experiment?
What connectome scope is fixed for the first topology experiment?
What identical learning contract should be used across topology arms?
rounds.answer: Initially selected frozen reservoir plus trainable readout, then asked whether LoRA could help.

rounds.question: How should a LoRA-like low-rank adapter be positioned in the causal claim?
rounds.answer: Make low-rank adaptation the primary method.

rounds.question: What is success in the first toy-game topology experiment?
rounds.answer: Real topology plus adapter should be compared with matched random/shuffled controls on mean return and sample efficiency under fixed compute/sample budget.

rounds.question: What matching contract is required for causal topology controls?
rounds.answer: Strict matched controls: preserve degree/edge-count/sign/weight-distribution properties where applicable, and match adapter rank, initialization family, optimizer, seeds, trainable parameter count, and compute/sample budgets.

components.description: Test topology value against strict matched controls using game return, sample efficiency, neural, biological, and compute metrics.
evidence: User selected Topology value as the primary publishable claim in Round 1 and Strict matched controls in Round 7.

state.codebase_context: Greenfield workspace: only agent/instruction and operational files; no product implementation to extend.

protocol.subset: MB+CX, FAFB v783, syn_count>=5, majority-neuropil + 1-hop interface
protocol.adapter: masked low-rank: (B@A)*M_arm, r=8 primary, sweep {2,8,32} secondary
protocol.budget: 10 seeds x 5e5 env steps x 4 arms; escalation to 1e6 re-runs ALL arms
protocol.learning_rule: surrogate-gradient truncated BPTT primary; e-prop secondary
protocol.stats: IQM + stratified bootstrap 95% CI, Holm over 2 primary comparisons
protocol.backends: PyTorch CUDA learning; Brian2 CPU cross-check

amendments.title: Two-host execution model
amendments.changes: P6 becomes device-agnostic: confirmatory on CUDA desktop (RTX 4070 Ti), development/pilots on Apple M1 Pro 16GB via MPS. GeNN/Brian2CUDA are CUDA-host-only. Adds cross-device spike agreement gate and dense/sparse equivalence gate. Adds shared lockfile + run metadata requirement.

amendments.title: Starting HP 20 -> 30
amendments.changes: P2 START_HP raised. At 20 HP racing beat board control 88% and games ended by turn 5-7: the optimum was degenerate and placed no demand on working memory, the capability CX was selected for. At 30 HP the strategic policy dominates and games run 10-22 turns / 72-139 decisions. Initial diagnosis (removal of taunt) was refuted by measurement: the control mirror is 51% at 22 turns, so the game itself was sound and the 74% skew was an artefact of the greedy bot.
amendments.residual: control mirror favours player two 60.8% - alternate seats and report per-seat win rates

amendments.title: Branching ratio replaces spectral radius
amendments.changes: P4 structural match: rho=0.95 understated the weight scale by ~1780x for a spiking substrate. At rho=0.95, 100% of 15,710 spikes stayed in directly-driven input neurons and none propagated, so all three arms returned byte-identical pilot scores. Replaced by branching ratio ~1 measured with no external drive; each arm gets its own scale.

amendments.title: Membrane readout; input-gain calibration removed
amendments.changes: P3 readout: spike counts leave the median output unit with zero variance across game states unless exactly at criticality; replaced by mean pre-reset membrane potential. P4 5 Hz input calibration removed as ill-posed once branching is fixed, replaced by one constant gain shared by all arms. Cost: the claim weakens from descending-neuron discharge to sub-threshold potential.
